blocks.tamil_translation: she said. Then the two of us went together to the presence of the Prophet ﷺ. I said, “O Messenger of Allah, from drawing water from the well again and again, a pain has developed in my chest,” and Hazrat Fatimah (RA) requested, “From grinding the hand-mill again and again, calluses have formed on my hands. Allah has sent you captives and has also granted some ease. So give us a servant too!” The Prophet ﷺ said, “By Allah! Because the Companions of the Suffah have been starving, marks of shrinking have appeared on their stomachs. I have nothing else to give them. Therefore, I will sell these slaves and spend that money on the Companions of the Suffah.” The two of us came back, and (that) night the two of us were lying under a small blanket. If we covered our heads with that blanket, the feet would be uncovered. If we covered the feet, the head would be uncovered. At that time, unexpectedly, the Prophet ﷺ came to our house. The two of us tried to get up at once. The Prophet ﷺ said, “Stay lying as you are!” and then asked, “You asked me for a servant; shall I teach you something better than that?” We said, “Do tell us, by all means!” The Prophet ﷺ said, “Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) taught me some words (Kalimahs). After every Salah, both of you should keep reciting Subhan Allah 10 times, Alhamdulillah 10 times and Allahu Akbar 10 times. When going to sleep, keep saying Subhan Allah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times and Allahu Akbar 34 times.” Hazrat Ali (RA) says, “By Allah!
